title: File:24Seven- UAV San Andreas Fault 17-13 EDT (26468252311).png
author: NASA Earth RIght Now
description:
Geophysicist Andrea Donnellan of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory and geologist Stephen DeLong of the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earthquake Science Center prepare a small unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and GPS instruments. They are documenting the topography of the creeping section of the San Andreas fault in Southern California. The topography of fault zones provides information on past earthquakes and how earthquake faults break and rupture. opentopography.org
Image credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech
